templatePurpose: Capture checklist skeleton for a post-2026-08-28 dated Simocracy funding snapshot. Do not commit a filled production file until an authoritative public artifact exists. Do not copy this template into simocracy-status-2026-08-28.json with invented values.

axisA_decisionStatus.description: Axis A — platform decision/procedural vocabulary exactly as represented by the authoritative artifact (for example provisional or ratified). Do not translate into a stronger project-defined state.

axisB_financialEvidence.description: Axis B — payment authorization, transfer, receipt, and settlement only when separately evidenced. Leave null/absent until evidence exists. Allocation or ratification alone is not payment.

repositoryBaseline.note: Record the exact Git commit SHA that preceded the Friday artifact capture. Prefer the pre-Friday checkpoint SHA current at freeze time, not a guessed historical SHA.

captureMetadata.notes: Fill only after the public artifact exists. Preserve exact bytes when lawful.

nonClaims: Null financial-evidence fields mean no such evidence is recorded yet; they do not prove an event did not occur elsewhere.
Platform decision status is not payment, transfer, receipt, or settlement.
